input.quote: (ii) setting agendas for meetings of each Decision-Making Committee with solicited input from members of the respective Committee
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binding Sanofi (or either Party). Targeted searches for "solicit", "no-hire", "recruit", "induce ... to leave employment", "employ or engage", "employees of the other Party", "personnel" and "shall not, directly or indirectly" returned no restrictive covenant; the only "solicit" hit is p0170 in the Governance article, referring to "solicited input" from Committee members, which is unrelated to hiring. Other employee/personnel references (e.g., debarment covenants at p0571, technical-personnel support at p0359, indemnity definitions at p0581/p0586) impose no hiring restriction. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicitation restriction on Customer), so no redline is proposed.
